    import "strings"

func GetClosestVowel(word string) string {
    vowels := map[rune]struct{}{
        'a': {},

        'i': {},
        'o': {},
        'u': {},
        'A': {},

    consonants := map[rune]struct{}{
        'b': {},

        'j': {},
        'k': {},

        'M': {},
        'N': {},
        'P': {},
        'Q': {},
        'R': {},
        'S': {},
        'T': {},
        'V': {},
        'W': {},
        'X': {},
        'Y': {},
        'Z': {},
    }

    word = word[1 : len(word)-1]

    for i := len(word) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
        if _, isVowel := vowels[rune(word[i])]; !isVowel {
            if i > 0 && i < len(word)-1 {
                if _, isConsonant1 := consonants[rune(word[i-1])]; isConsonant1 {
                    if _, isConsonant2 := consonants[rune(word[i+1])]; isConsonant2 {
                        return string(word[i])
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return ""
}

func Simplify(x, n string) bool {
    xx := strings.Split(x, "/")
    nn := strings.Split(n, "/")
    a, _ := strconv.Atoi(xx[0])
    b, _ := strconv.Atoi(xx[1])
    c, _ := strconv.Atoi(nn[0])
    d, _ := strconv.Atoi(nn[1])
    numerator := float64(a*c)
    denom := float64(b*d)
    return numerator/denom == float64(int(numerator/denom))
}

func IntToMiniRoman(number int) string {
    func IntToMiniRoman(number int) string {
    roman := ""

    for number > 0 {
        switch {
        case number >= 1000:
            roman += "m"
            number -= 1000
        case number >= 900:
            roman += "cm"
            number -= 900
        case number >= 500:
            roman += "d"
            number -= 500
        case number >= 400:
            roman += "cd"
            number -= 400
        case number >= 100:
            roman += "c"
            number -= 100
        case number >= 90:
            roman += "xc"
            number -= 90
        case number >= 50:
            roman += "l"
            number -= 50
        case number >= 40:
            roman += "xl"
            number -= 40
        case number >= 10:
            roman += "x"
            number -= 10
        case number >= 9:
            roman += "ix"
            number -= 9
        case number >= 5:
            roman += "v"
            number -= 5
        case number >= 4:
            roman += "iv"
            number -= 4
        default:
            roman += "i"
            number--
        }
    }

    return strings.ToLower(roman)
}
